name: Showa Retro
summary: Showa Retro (昭和レトロ) is a Japanese aesthetic based on the nostalgia for the Showa era, which corresponds with 1926 to 1989 in the Gregorian calendar (primarily focusing on the aftermath of World War II, specifically 1950s to 1970s).
description: Showa Retro (昭和レトロ) is a Japanese aesthetic based on the nostalgia for the Showa era, which corresponds with 1926 to 1989 in the Gregorian calendar (primarily focusing on the aftermath of World War II, specifically 1950s to 1970s).
